name: Thaumaturgy (Path of Shadowcrafting) — Basic — Shadow Taunt

system.description:
You sympathetically link a distant natural shadow you can see to your own, forcing it to mimic your motions — japing, threatening, or contorting in an unnerving pantomime. The controlled shadow cannot make sound, harm anyone, or break from its source, but the display is deeply disquieting. This has no effect on shadows created by Obtenebration.

This path does not function against or for Kindred with the Flaw: Cast No Reflection.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
